decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The floodlights, hereby permitted, shall only be operated between the hours of 14.00 and 22.00 and during no more than three evenings in any one week.

Condition : 3 - The floodlights hereby approved shall not be erected until details that demonstrate that there will be no significant light spillage beyond the immediate area of the football pitch have been submitted to and agreed in writing by the local planning authority.  The floodlights shall not be operated other than in accordance with such details.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until full details of a scheme to provide car parking within the currently derelict tennis courts has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  This scheme, as approved, shall be implemented in full and maintained permanently.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until full details of an enhanced means of enclosure around Rectory Meadow has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  This scheme, as approved, shall be implemented in full.  The scheme should enhance the existing natural boundary and provide for free pedestrian access for the general public.

Condition : 6 - A landscape and premises management plan, including long-term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas and structures, shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the development or any phrase of the development, whichever is the sooner, for its permitted use. The management plan shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 7 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed erection of new 15m high floodlights, and a new spectator stand comprising of 100 seats and 102 standing capacity, to the football ground, by way of their size, scale and location would not represent an obtrusive design and would not have an adverse impact upon the general amenity of the immediate locality and would complement the sites existing use a recreational ground while respecting the open, spacious nature of the greenbelt area within which it is located and is therefore in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-N.1.2 (Acceptable Development in the Green Belt), ENV-P.1.7 (Light Pollution) and C.5.4 (New Small Private Sports and Leisure Facilities) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: The erection of new 15m high folding floodlights around one full sized football pitch, and a new spectator stand to accommodate 100 seats, 102 standing capacity and space for 3 wheelchairs.
